integrity: A self-contained proof supplies the general theorem; finite exhaustive code checks are corroboration, not an infinite proof or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The exact bound concerns only fixed, nonadaptive atomic-knowledge queries with complete labelled truth-set outputs.
The intuitionistic partial order and carrier are known, and the one-agent accessibility is an unknown triangle-confluent equivalence relation.
Full-world queries, unrestricted preparations and noiseless observation are essential assumptions; adaptive and restricted-observer costs may differ.
Historical priority against all rough-set identification and concept-learning literature is not independently established.
title: Sharp nonadaptive knowledge tomography on finite intuitionistic S5 frames
